Walk in, or book ahead

Walk-ins are welcome whenever we're open. For longer styles, book ahead so your time is held.

Need a slot outside 8am–10pm? Out-of-hours appointments are available for £15 extra.

Booking policies

So everyone gets their full time in the chair.

Payments

A £15 non-refundable deposit secures your spot. The rest is due at your appointment, by cash, card or bank transfer.

Running late

More than 15 minutes late adds a £15 fee, plus £5 for every 5 minutes after that. Over 30 minutes late, your service may be shortened or rescheduled.

Rescheduling

Free up to 24 hours before. Changes within 24 hours cost £5.

Guests

To keep the studio relaxed, let us know before your appointment if you're bringing anyone, including children, unless they're booked in too.

Cancellations

Cancelling less than 12 hours before means a new deposit is needed to rebook, and the original deposit isn't refunded.

Refunds

Refunds aren't available after a service. If something isn't right, message us within 12 hours for a free adjustment.
